examinations.name: Abdominal Examination
examinations.description: Evaluate abdominal organs and tenderness by palpation, percussion, and auscultation.

examinations.name: Abdominal Thrusts
examinations.description: Upward thrusts to the upper abdomen to relieve foreign-body airway obstruction.

examinations.name: Anterior Drawer Test
examinations.description: Assess anterior cruciate ligament laxity by anterior displacement of the tibia.

examinations.name: Anterior Rhinoscopy
examinations.description: Visual inspection of the nasal cavity using a nasal speculum and light source.

examinations.name: Anthropometry
examinations.description: Measurement of body size and proportions, including height, weight, and circumferences.

examinations.name: Apgar Score
examinations.description: Rapid assessment of newborn heart rate, respiratory effort, muscle tone, reflex irritability, and skin color.

examinations.name: Báez Sign
examinations.description: Elicit pain by compressing the femoral head in suspected hip disease.

examinations.name: Brachial Plexus Traction Test
examinations.description: Elicit symptoms by stretching the brachial plexus to assess nerve involvement.

examinations.name: Breast Examination
examinations.description: Inspect and palpate the breasts and lymph nodes for masses or abnormalities.

examinations.name: Capillary Fragility Test (Tourniquet Test)
examinations.description: Assess capillary fragility by counting petechiae after cuff occlusion.

examinations.name: Chest Expansion Measurement
examinations.description: Measure chest wall mobility during inspiration and expiration.

examinations.name: Comprehensive Eye Examination
examinations.description: Comprehensive assessment of vision, ocular structures, and eye function.

examinations.name: Corneal Examination
examinations.description: Assess corneal clarity and defects, often with fluorescein staining.

examinations.name: Cover Test
examinations.description: Detect ocular misalignment by observing refixation movements during cover.

examinations.name: Dermoscopy
examinations.description: Magnified examination of skin lesions to improve diagnostic accuracy for pigmented lesions.

examinations.name: Digital Rectal Examination (DRE)
examinations.description: Palpate the rectum and prostate to assess masses, tone, or tenderness.

examinations.name: Eversion Stress Test
examinations.description: Apply eversion stress to the ankle to assess lateral ankle ligament injury.

examinations.name: Exophthalmometry
examinations.description: Measure the degree of globe protrusion to assess exophthalmos.

examinations.name: External Eye Examination
examinations.description: Examine the eyelids, conjunctiva, and ocular surface for visible abnormalities.

examinations.name: External Genital Examination
examinations.description: Examine the external genitalia for lesions, inflammation, or structural abnormalities.

examinations.name: Eyelid Examination
examinations.description: Assess eyelid position, movement, and lesions affecting ocular protection.

examinations.name: Femoral Nerve Stretch Test
examinations.description: Assess L2-L4 radiculopathy or peripheral neuropathy by stretching the femoral nerve.

examinations.name: Ferriman-Gallwey Score
examinations.description: Score hair growth distribution to quantify hirsutism severity.

examinations.name: Fetal Heart Rate Auscultation
examinations.description: Auscultate the fetal heart rate to assess fetal status.

examinations.name: Fingertip-to-floor Test
examinations.description: Measure forward trunk flexion by the distance from the fingertips to the floor.

examinations.name: Gonioscopy
examinations.description: Examine the anterior chamber angle to assess glaucoma and angle anatomy.

examinations.name: Hip Abduction Test
examinations.description: Assess range of motion and pain during hip abduction.

examinations.name: Nasopharyngeal Examination
examinations.description: Assess the nasopharynx for masses, inflammation, or obstruction.

examinations.name: Neurological Examination
examinations.description: Assess mental status, cranial nerves, muscle strength, sensation, reflexes, and coordination.

examinations.name: Occiput-to-wall Test
examinations.description: Measure thoracic kyphosis by the distance between the occiput and the wall.

examinations.name: Ocular Motility Examination
examinations.description: Assess extraocular muscle movement to detect palsy or limited range.

examinations.name: Ophthalmoscopy
examinations.description: Examine the retina and optic disc using an ophthalmoscope.

examinations.name: Oral Examination
examinations.description: Examine the lips, oral mucosa, teeth, gums, tongue, and palate for abnormalities.

examinations.name: Oropharyngeal Examination
examinations.description: Examine the tonsils, uvula, and posterior pharyngeal wall for inflammation or lesions.

examinations.name: Orthostatic Vital Signs
examinations.description: Measure vital signs supine and standing to assess orthostatic hypotension.

examinations.name: Otoscopy
examinations.description: Examine the external auditory canal and tympanic membrane using an otoscope.

examinations.name: Patellar Grind Test (Clarke Sign)
examinations.description: Compress the patella during quadriceps contraction to assess patellofemoral pain.

examinations.name: Patellar Ballottement Test
examinations.description: Check for a floating patella by tapping the patella to detect knee joint effusion.

examinations.name: Patrick Test (FABER)
examinations.description: Assess hip or sacroiliac joint disease by flexion-abduction-external rotation.

examinations.name: Pelvic Compression and Distraction Test
examinations.description: Provoke sacroiliac joint pain by compressing or distracting the pelvic ring.

examinations.name: Pelvic Examination
examinations.description: Assess female pelvic organs by inspection and bimanual examination.

examinations.name: Penile Measurement
examinations.description: Measure penile length and circumference for clinical assessment or documentation.

examinations.name: Periodontal Probing
examinations.description: Measure periodontal pocket depth to assess the severity of gum disease.

examinations.name: Phalen Test
examinations.description: Flex the wrist to provoke median nerve symptoms of carpal tunnel syndrome.

examinations.name: Physical Examination
examinations.description: Systematic assessment using inspection, palpation, percussion, and auscultation.

examinations.name: Piedallu Sign
examinations.description: Assess sacroiliac joint dysfunction by asymmetry in posterior superior iliac spine movement.

examinations.name: Pneumatic Otoscopy
examinations.description: Apply air pressure with an otoscope bulb to assess tympanic membrane mobility.

examinations.name: Probing Examination
examinations.description: Use a probe to explore the depth and patency of wounds, sinus tracts, or fistulas.

examinations.name: Prone Knee Bend Test
examinations.description: Assess femoral nerve or lumbar nerve root irritation by knee flexion in the prone position.

examinations.name: Pull Test
examinations.description: Assess postural stability by observing the balance response to a backward pull.

examinations.name: Pupillary Light Reflex Examination
examinations.description: Assess pupillary constriction to light and its symmetry.

examinations.name: Red Reflex Examination
examinations.description: Screen for opacification of the ocular refractive media by observing the red reflex of the fundus.

examinations.name: Schober Test
examinations.description: Measure lumbar flexion to assess reduced mobility.

examinations.name: Single-Leg Squat Test
examinations.description: Assess lower-limb strength, balance, and dynamic knee control.

examinations.name: Skin Examination
examinations.description: Examine the skin for lesions, rash, color changes, and other abnormalities.

examinations.name: Skin and Sclera Examination
examinations.description: Examine the skin and sclera for jaundice, pallor, and color abnormalities.

examinations.name: Slit-Lamp Examination
examinations.description: Microscopically examine anterior segment structures using a slit beam of light.

examinations.name: Fluorescein-Stained Slit-Lamp Examination
examinations.description: Use fluorescein to detect corneal defects and assess the tear film.

examinations.name: Spinal Lateral Flexion Test
examinations.description: Assess the range of lateral spinal flexion.

examinations.name: Spurling Test
examinations.description: Reproduce cervical radiculopathy symptoms by neck extension with applied compression.

examinations.name: Strabismus Assessment
examinations.description: Assess ocular alignment and extraocular muscle movement to identify misalignment.

examinations.name: Straight Leg Raise Test (SLRT)
examinations.description: Assess for sciatic nerve irritation by raising the straightened lower limb.

examinations.name: Talar Tilt Test
examinations.description: Assess lateral ankle ligament instability by tilting the talus.

examinations.name: Thomas Test
examinations.description: Assess hip flexor tightness and hip extension range of motion.

examinations.name: Tinel Sign
examinations.description: Elicit tingling by tapping a nerve to assess for nerve irritation.

examinations.name: Vital Signs
examinations.description: Measure temperature, pulse, respiration, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation.

examinations.name: Wood's Lamp Examination
examinations.description: Use ultraviolet light to detect fungal infection or pigmentary changes.

examinations.name: Von Graefe Sign
examinations.description: Assess lid lag on downward gaze, commonly seen in hyperthyroidism.

examinations.name: Adrenal Function Tests
examinations.description: Assess abnormalities of adrenal hormone secretion and reserve function.

examinations.name: Adrenocorticotropic Hormone (ACTH) Test
examinations.description: Measure ACTH to assess pituitary-adrenal axis function.

examinations.name: Alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP) Test
examinations.description: Measure AFP to screen for liver cancer or monitor tumors.

examinations.name: Anemia Panel
examinations.description: Assess anemia using CBC, iron studies, and related indices.

examinations.name: Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) Test
examinations.description: Measure AMH to assess ovarian reserve and reproductive potential.

examinations.name: Arterial Blood Gas (ABG)
examinations.description: Measure arterial oxygenation, ventilation, and acid-base status.

examinations.name: B-Type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP)
examinations.description: Measure BNP to help assess the severity of heart failure.

examinations.name: Beta-2 Microglobulin Test
examinations.description: Measure beta-2 microglobulin to assess lymphoproliferative disorders and renal function.

examinations.name: Blood Ammonia Test
examinations.description: Measure blood ammonia to assess liver function and risk of encephalopathy.

examinations.name: Blood Biomarker Analysis
examinations.description: Analyze specific blood markers to assess disease activity or risk.

examinations.name: Blood Glucose Test
examinations.description: Measure blood glucose to screen for or monitor diabetes.

examinations.name: Blood Tests
examinations.description: Assess health status and diagnose disease through laboratory analysis of blood.

examinations.name: Blood Typing and Crossmatch
examinations.description: Determine blood type and transfusion compatibility.

examinations.name: Bone Marrow Examination
examinations.description: Evaluate bone marrow cells to diagnose hematologic disorders.

examinations.name: Bone Turnover Markers (BTMs)
examinations.description: Measure bone formation and bone resorption markers to assess bone metabolism.

examinations.name: C-Reactive Protein (CRP)
examinations.description: Measure CRP as a marker of inflammation or infection.

examinations.name: Calcitonin Test
examinations.description: Measure calcitonin to assess the risk of medullary thyroid carcinoma.

examinations.name: Cardiac Enzyme Panel
examinations.description: Measure cardiac markers to detect myocardial injury.

examinations.name: Catecholamine Assay
examinations.description: Measure catecholamines to assess for pheochromocytoma or sympathetic overactivity.

examinations.name: Chromogranin a (CgA) Test
examinations.description: Measure CgA as a neuroendocrine tumor marker.

examinations.name: Chromogranin B (CgB) Test
examinations.description: Measure CgB to help assess neuroendocrine tumor activity.

examinations.name: Coagulation Panel
examinations.description: Assess coagulation with tests such as PT, INR, and aPTT.

examinations.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
examinations.description: Measure blood cell counts to assess anemia, infection, and platelet status.

examinations.name: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
examinations.description: Assess electrolytes, renal function, liver enzymes, and glucose levels.

examinations.name: Cortisol Test
examinations.description: Measure cortisol to assess adrenal function and stress response.

examinations.name: Erythrocyte Enzyme Testing
examinations.description: Measure erythrocyte enzyme activity to diagnose enzymopathies.

examinations.name: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
examinations.description: Measure ESR as a nonspecific marker of inflammation.

examinations.name: Fasting Blood Glucose (FBG)
examinations.description: Measure fasting blood glucose to screen for diabetes or prediabetes.

examinations.name: Gastric Cancer Screening Panel
examinations.description: Blood markers that assess gastric mucosal status and cancer risk.

examinations.name: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c)
examinations.description: Measure the average blood glucose level over the past 2–3 months.

examinations.name: Hemoglobin Electrophoresis
examinations.description: Separate different hemoglobin types to detect sickle cell disease and thalassemia.

examinations.name: High-Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein (hs-CRP)
examinations.description: Measure low-grade inflammation to help assess cardiovascular risk.

examinations.name: Homocysteine Testing
examinations.description: Measures homocysteine to assess B-vitamin status and vascular risk.

examinations.name: Hormone Panel
examinations.description: Measures multiple hormones to assess endocrine function and imbalances.

examinations.name: Human Chorionic Gonadotropin (hCG) Test
examinations.description: Detects hCG to confirm pregnancy or monitor related conditions.

examinations.name: Inflammatory Marker Panel
examinations.description: Measures multiple blood markers to assess systemic inflammation or infection.

examinations.name: Insulin and C-Peptide Release Test
examinations.description: Assesses insulin secretion by measuring insulin and C-peptide responses.

examinations.name: Iron Studies
examinations.description: Assesses iron status using ferritin, serum iron, TIBC, and saturation.

examinations.name: Lipid Panel
examinations.description: Measures cholesterol and triglycerides to assess cardiovascular risk.

examinations.name: Liver Fibrosis Panel
examinations.description: Uses blood biomarkers and algorithms to estimate liver fibrosis risk.

examinations.name: Liver Function Tests (LFTs)
examinations.description: Measures liver enzymes and proteins to assess liver injury and hepatic function.

examinations.name: Liver and Kidney Function Tests (LFTs/RFTs)
examinations.description: Uses a comprehensive blood chemistry panel to assess liver and kidney function.

examinations.name: Maternal Serum Screening
examinations.description: Screens blood markers during pregnancy to assess risk of fetal chromosomal abnormalities or neural tube defects.

examinations.name: Metabolic Screening
examinations.description: Screens blood and urine to detect metabolic disorders and nutritional abnormalities.

examinations.name: Metanephrines Testing
examinations.description: Measures metanephrines to assess for pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma.

examinations.name: N-Terminal Pro-B-Type Natriuretic Peptide (NT-proBNP)
examinations.description: Measures NT-proBNP to aid in the diagnosis and monitoring of heart failure.

examinations.name: Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT)
examinations.description: Measures blood glucose after oral glucose administration to diagnose diabetes or gestational diabetes.

examinations.name: Pancreatic Enzyme Testing
examinations.description: Measures amylase and lipase to assess pancreatitis or pancreatic injury.

examinations.name: Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) Testing
examinations.description: Measures PTH to assess calcium balance and parathyroid function.

examinations.name: Peripheral Blood Smear
examinations.description: Microscopic review of blood cells to assess morphology and abnormalities.

examinations.name: Pituitary Hormone Panel
examinations.description: Measures pituitary hormones to assess pituitary function and its regulation.

examinations.name: Plasma Amino Acid Analysis
examinations.description: Measures plasma amino acids to diagnose metabolic or nutritional disorders.

examinations.name: Plasma Arginine Vasopressin (AVP) Testing
examinations.description: Measures AVP to assess disorders of water balance and diabetes insipidus.

examinations.name: Procalcitonin (PCT)
examinations.description: Measures procalcitonin to aid in detecting bacterial infection and assessing sepsis severity.

examinations.name: Renal Function Tests (RFTs)
examinations.description: Assesses kidney function using creatinine, urea, and related measures.

examinations.name: Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone System (RAAS) Testing
examinations.description: Measures renin and aldosterone to assess hypertension and adrenal disorders.

examinations.name: Serum Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (SACE) Measurement
examinations.description: Measures ACE levels to aid in the assessment of sarcoidosis and related disorders.

examinations.name: Serum Electrolytes
examinations.description: Measures sodium, potassium, chloride, and bicarbonate to assess fluid and electrolyte balance.

examinations.name: Serum Enzyme Analysis
examinations.description: Measures specific enzymes to assess tissue injury or organ function.

examinations.name: Serum Erythropoietin Level
examinations.description: Measures erythropoietin to assess the cause of anemia or erythrocytosis.

examinations.name: Serum Protein Electrophoresis (SPEP)
examinations.description: Performs serum protein electrophoresis to detect monoclonal gammopathy.

examinations.name: Serum Serotonin (5-HT) Testing
examinations.description: Measures serotonin to assess carcinoid syndrome or related disorders.

examinations.name: Sex Hormone Panel
examinations.description: Measures sex hormones to assess fertility, pubertal development, or endocrine disorders.

examinations.name: Thrombopoietin (TPO) Testing
examinations.description: Measures thrombopoietin to assess the cause of thrombocytopenia.

examinations.name: Thyroid Function Tests (TFTs)
examinations.description: Measures thyroid hormones and TSH to assess thyroid function.

examinations.name: Trace Element Testing
examinations.description: Measures trace minerals to detect deficiency or toxic exposure.

examinations.name: Tumor Marker Panel
examinations.description: Measures multiple tumor markers in blood to aid in oncologic assessment.

examinations.name: Vitamin D Testing
examinations.description: Measures vitamin D levels to assess bone and mineral health.

examinations.name: Vitamin and Mineral Measurement
examinations.description: Measures selected vitamins and minerals to assess nutritional status.

examinations.name: 24-Hour Urine Thiamine Test
examinations.description: Measures 24-hour thiamine excretion to assess vitamin B1 status.

examinations.name: 24-Hour Urine Electrolytes
examinations.description: Measures 24-hour urine electrolytes to assess renal handling.

examinations.name: 24-Hour Urine Metabolic Evaluation
examinations.description: Evaluates urine metabolites to assess kidney stone risk and metabolic status.

examinations.name: 24-Hour Urine Protein
examinations.description: Measures total protein excretion to assess kidney disease.

examinations.name: Fecal Fluoride Test
examinations.description: Measures fluoride in stool to assess fluoride exposure or intake.

examinations.name: Fecal Occult Blood Test (FOBT)
examinations.description: Detects occult blood in stool for colorectal bleeding screening.

examinations.name: Meares-Stamey Four-Glass Test
examinations.description: Cultures segmented urine and prostatic fluid specimens to localize the site of infection in prostatitis.

examinations.name: Stool Color Card Test
examinations.description: Screens for infant cholestasis and biliary atresia by comparing stool color against a color card.

examinations.name: Stool Ova and Parasites (O&P) Examination
examinations.description: Microscopic examination of stool for parasite ova and organisms.

examinations.name: Routine Stool Examination
examinations.description: Assesses stool for signs of infection, blood, and basic digestive abnormalities.

examinations.name: Two-Glass Test
examinations.description: Compares first-void and midstream urine to help localize urinary tract infection.

examinations.name: Urinalysis (UA)
examinations.description: Screens urine for infection, kidney disease, and metabolic disorders.

examinations.name: Urine 5-Hydroxyindoleacetic Acid (5-HIAA) Test
examinations.description: Measures urine 5-HIAA to assess for serotonin-secreting carcinoid tumors.

examinations.name: Urine 5-HTP (5-hydroxytryptophan) Test
examinations.description: Detects urine 5-HTP (5-hydroxytryptophan) for metabolic assessment.

examinations.name: Urine Calcium Test
examinations.description: Measures urine calcium to assess stone risk and calcium metabolism.

examinations.name: Urine Cystine Test
examinations.description: Detects elevated urine cystine to assess cystinuria and stone risk.

examinations.name: Urine Electrolyte Test
examinations.description: Measures urine electrolytes to assess renal handling and fluid balance.

examinations.name: Urine Fluoride Test
examinations.description: Measures urine fluoride to assess fluoride exposure or fluorosis.

examinations.name: Urine Hydroxyproline Test
examinations.description: Measures urine hydroxyproline to assess collagen breakdown and bone turnover.

examinations.name: Urine Lysozyme Test
examinations.description: Measures urine lysozyme to assess renal tubular injury or monocytic leukemia.

examinations.name: Urine Organic Acid Analysis
examinations.description: Analyzes the urine organic acid profile to detect inborn errors of metabolism.

examinations.name: Urine Pterin Analysis
examinations.description: Measures urine pterins to assess neurotransmitter and BH4 metabolism disorders.

examinations.name: Urine 5-HT (Serotonin) Test
examinations.description: Measures urine serotonin to assess serotonin-secreting tumors.

examinations.name: Urinary Stone Analysis
examinations.description: Analyzes passed or removed stones to determine their composition and cause.

examinations.name: Urine Succinylacetone Level
examinations.description: Measures urine succinylacetone for the diagnosis of tyrosinemia type I.

examinations.name: Urine Uric Acid Test
examinations.description: Measures urine uric acid to assess gout risk and stone formation.

examinations.name: Urine VMA (Vanillylmandelic Acid) Test
examinations.description: Measures urine VMA to assess catecholamine-secreting tumors.

examinations.name: Urine White Blood Cell Excretion Rate Test
examinations.description: Measures urine white blood cell excretion to assess urinary tract inflammation.

examinations.name: Urine Culture
examinations.description: Performs urine culture to diagnose urinary tract infection.

examinations.name: Urine Protein Electrophoresis (UPEP)
examinations.description: Separates urine proteins to detect monoclonal proteins and kidney disease.

examinations.name: Urine hCG Pregnancy Test
examinations.description: Detects urine hCG to confirm pregnancy.

examinations.name: Actinomyces Antibody Test
examinations.description: Detects antibodies suggesting Actinomyces infection or exposure.

examinations.name: Allergen Testing (Bioresonance)
examinations.description: An alternative method claimed to detect allergies; not scientifically validated.

examinations.name: Allergy Testing
examinations.description: Identifies allergen sensitization by skin testing or specific IgE blood tests.

examinations.name: Anti-actin Antibody
examinations.description: Detects anti-actin antibodies, which help support the diagnosis of type 1 autoimmune hepatitis.

examinations.name: Anti-cyclic Citrullinated Peptide Antibody (Anti-CCP)
examinations.description: Detects anti-CCP antibodies to help diagnose rheumatoid arthritis.

examinations.name: Anti-double-stranded DNA Antibody (anti-dsDNA)
examinations.description: Detects anti-dsDNA antibodies to support the diagnosis of lupus and monitor disease activity.

examinations.name: Anti-endomysial Antibody (EMA)
examinations.description: Detects EMA antibodies to support the diagnosis of celiac disease.

examinations.name: Anti-endothelial Cell Antibody (AECA)
examinations.description: Detects anti-endothelial cell antibodies, associated with certain vasculitic disorders.

examinations.name: Anti-intrinsic Factor Antibody
examinations.description: Detects the antibodies causing vitamin B12 malabsorption in pernicious anemia.

examinations.name: Anti-keratin Antibody (AKA)
examinations.description: Detects anti-keratin antibodies associated with rheumatoid arthritis.

examinations.name: Antimitochondrial Antibody (AMA)
examinations.description: Detects AMA to support the diagnosis of primary biliary cholangitis.

examinations.name: Anti-parietal Cell Antibody
examinations.description: Detects antibodies associated with autoimmune gastritis and risk of pernicious anemia.

examinations.name: Anti-perinuclear Factor (APF)
examinations.description: Detects APF antibodies associated with rheumatoid arthritis.

examinations.name: Anti-platelet Antibody Test
examinations.description: Detects platelet antibodies for suspected immune thrombocytopenia.

examinations.name: Anti-reticulin Antibody
examinations.description: Detects anti-reticulin antibodies, historically associated with celiac disease.

examinations.name: Anti-smooth Muscle Antibody (ASMA)
examinations.description: Detects ASMA to support the diagnosis of autoimmune hepatitis.

examinations.name: Antigen Test
examinations.description: Detects specific microbial antigens for rapid diagnosis of infection.

examinations.name: Antigen and Antibody Test
examinations.description: Detects antigens and/or antibodies to diagnose infection or assess immune status.

examinations.name: Anti-neutrophil Cytoplasmic Antibody (ANCA) Panel
examinations.description: Detects ANCA to aid in the diagnosis and classification of ANCA-associated vasculitis.

examinations.name: Antinuclear Antibody (ANA) Panel
examinations.description: Screens for ANA and its patterns for evaluation of systemic autoimmune disease.

examinations.name: Antiphospholipid Antibody (APA) Panel
examinations.description: Detects antiphospholipid antibodies to assess thrombosis risk and APS.

examinations.name: Antistreptolysin O (ASO) Titer
examinations.description: Detects ASO antibodies to assess recent streptococcal infection.

examinations.name: Autoimmune Hepatitis (AIH) Antibody Panel
examinations.description: Detects autoantibodies associated with AIH to support the diagnosis of autoimmune hepatitis.

examinations.name: Autoimmune Screening Panel
examinations.description: A panel of autoantibody tests for evaluation of suspected autoimmune disease.

examinations.name: Autologous Serum Skin Test (ASST)
examinations.description: A skin test using the patient's serum to assess autoimmune chronic urticaria.

examinations.name: Bullous Pemphigoid (BP) Antibody Test
examinations.description: Detects BP180/BP230 antibodies to support the diagnosis of bullous pemphigoid.

examinations.name: C1 Esterase Inhibitor Assay
examinations.description: Measures C1 inhibitor to diagnose hereditary or acquired angioedema.

examinations.name: Casoni Intradermal Test
examinations.description: A historical skin test for echinococcosis, now largely obsolete.

examinations.name: Chlamydia Pneumoniae Antibody Test
examinations.description: Detects antibodies suggesting past or recent Chlamydia pneumoniae infection.

examinations.name: Cold Agglutinin Test
examinations.description: Detects cold-reactive antibodies that cause hemolysis in cold agglutinin disease.

examinations.name: Complement Component Analysis
examinations.description: Measures complement protein levels to assess immune and inflammatory function.

examinations.name: Complement Fixation Test (CFT)
examinations.description: Detects specific antibodies by measuring complement consumption in the reaction.

examinations.name: Conjunctival Provocation Test
examinations.description: Instillation of allergen into the eye to assess immediate allergic conjunctival reaction.

examinations.name: Cryoglobulin Testing
examinations.description: Detection of cold-precipitable proteins in blood associated with vasculitis and infection.

examinations.name: Cysticercus Antibody Testing
examinations.description: Detection of antibodies to Taenia solium larvae to diagnose cysticercosis.

examinations.name: Cytokine Panel
examinations.description: Measurement of multiple cytokines to assess immune activation and inflammatory patterns.

examinations.name: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Antibody Testing
examinations.description: Detection of CMV antibodies to assess prior exposure or recent infection.

examinations.name: Dengue Virus Antibody Testing
examinations.description: Detection of dengue antibodies to support diagnosis of current or past infection.

examinations.name: Direct Antiglobulin Test (DAT)
examinations.description: Detects antibodies or complement bound to the surface of red blood cells.

examinations.name: Direct Immunofluorescence Assay (DFA)
examinations.description: Uses fluorescent antibodies to directly detect antigens in patient specimens.

examinations.name: Dot Immunogold Filtration Assay (DIGFA)
examinations.description: Rapid membrane assay using colloidal gold labels to detect specific antibodies or antigens.

examinations.name: Echinococcus Antibody Testing
examinations.description: Detects Echinococcus antibodies to aid diagnosis of echinococcosis.

examinations.name: Enzyme-linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA)
examinations.description: Enzyme-based detection or quantification of specific antibodies or antigens.

examinations.name: Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV) Antibody Panel
examinations.description: Detection of EBV antibodies to determine acute, past, or reactivated infection.

examinations.name: Filarial Antibody Testing
examinations.description: Detects filarial antibodies to aid diagnosis of lymphatic or tissue filariasis.

examinations.name: Flow Cytometric Immunophenotyping
examinations.description: Uses flow cytometry to identify cell populations by surface markers.

examinations.name: Globulin Precipitation Test
examinations.description: Assesses abnormal globulins by observing precipitation reactions in serum.

examinations.name: HLA-B27 Typing
examinations.description: Determines HLA-B27 status to assess risk associated with spondyloarthritis.

examinations.name: HLA-DR4 Typing
examinations.description: Determines HLA-DR4 alleles to assess susceptibility to autoimmune disease.

examinations.name: Helicobacter Pylori Antibody Testing
examinations.description: Detects H. pylori antibodies, indicating exposure or infection.

examinations.name: Hemagglutination Inhibition (HI) Test
